subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should this PR land with interrupted subagent announce delivery turns reconciled as non-running `killed` sessions and all subagent completion announce handoffs forced tool-free across CLI, embedded, and Codex native runtimes?
rationale: The remaining choice is not a line-level defect: it changes persisted session recovery semantics and a security-relevant tool boundary, which tests can prove but not approve as product/runtime policy.

options.title: Land after lint rerun
options.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then land if maintainers accept the persisted announce marker and tool-free delivery policy.

options.title: Change recovery status first
options.body: If `killed` is not the desired stored status for aborted delivery-only announce turns, update that state transition before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery design
options.body: If announce-specific recovery should instead become a generic inter-session delivery model, pause this PR and route that design explicitly.

recommendation.title: Land after lint rerun
recommendation.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then land if maintainers accept the persisted announce marker and tool-free delivery policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work spans the restart recovery lifecycle seam and Codex internal-turn behavior that define the remaining merge-risk decision.
